The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 48 epochs. That removes the yield an attacker would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Repeating the trick 48 times costs 7 separate deposits and 36 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
